title: ReTouchGS: Ultralight Render-free Aesthetic Color Enhancement and Transfer for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2611.23054v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables photorealistic scene reconstruction. Existing 3DGS color transfer and interactive editing methods are guided by reference images and user-specified color adjustments. However, in many applications, users simply want aesthetically guided color enhancement that automatically makes the scene more visually appealing while maintaining consistent colors and tones across viewpoints. We present ReTouchGS, to our knowledge the first framework for reference-free aesthetic color enhancement of pretrained 3DGS models. It predicts a scene-level color lookup table (LUT) from the model and its associated camera parameters. ReTouchGS also supports reference-guided color transfer by fitting a scene-level LUT using one edited view of the same scene and its corresponding original render. translated_title: ReTouchGS：面向3D高斯泼溅的超轻量级免渲染美学色彩增强与迁移
translated_abstract: 三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）能够实现照片级真实的场景重建。现有的3DGS色彩迁移和交互式编辑方法均由参考图像和用户指定的颜色调整来引导。然而，在许多应用中，用户只是希望获得美学引导的色彩增强，能够自动使场景在视觉上更具吸引力，同时在不同视点间保持颜色和色调的一致性。我们提出了ReTouchGS，据我们所知，这是首个针对预训练3DGS模型的免参考美学色彩增强框架。该方法从模型及其关联的相机参数预测场景级颜色查找表（LUT）。ReTouchGS还支持参考引导的色彩迁移，即利用同一场景的一个编辑视图及其对应的原始渲染来拟合场景级LUT。一个仅含44.7K参数的共享混合感知颜色细化网络对解析颜色更新进行细化，以实现色彩增强或色彩迁移。
tldr: ReTouchGS是首个面向预训练3D高斯泼溅模型的免参考美学色彩增强框架，通过从模型和相机参数预测场景级颜色查找表，并借助仅44.7K参数的轻量级混合感知细化网络，实现无需渲染的、跨视点一致的自动美学色彩增强与参考引导色彩迁移。
en_tdlr: ReTouchGS is the first reference-free aesthetic color enhancement framework for pretrained 3D Gaussian Splatting models, predicting scene-level color LUTs from the model and camera parameters and refining them with an ultralight 44.7K-parameter blend-aware network to achieve render-free, view-consistent color enhancement and reference-guided color transfer.
